outcome_statement: The drive channel surfaces a clean human handoff when it's genuinely stuck (needs a verification code, CAPTCHA answer, OTP) instead of re-clicking the same element for the whole step budget, and resumes automatically once the founder submits the value.
pain: Twice tonight the drive loop got stuck re-clicking the same email-verification field with no way for Adam to just supply the code and let it continue.
value: Unblocks any future goal that needs a one-time human input (2FA codes, CAPTCHAs, OTPs) without falling back to fully manual driving.
success_metrics: A synthetic stuck fixture surfaces status:handoff with a real selector/label
POST /handoff-resume types the value and resumes the loop
failure_metrics: Handoff triggers on a normal (non-stuck) step
constraints: Reuses runBrowserGoal's existing onAfterStep hook -- no change to services/general-browser-agent.js
unacceptable_result: Any change beyond the handoff detection + /handoff-resume route
ownership: ARC emits machine twin; Builder executes; Adam owns founder usability verdict
priority_fit: Urgent live bugfix -- directly unblocks the in-progress Fiverr signup -- rank 34

point_model.A: Vision -- Adam provides FP in development stage
point_model.B: Chair locks handoff -- corridor protected; Adam done until Alpha
